name: Exec Cluster E01: Hold Duration + Strict Hold
source:
# =============================================================================
# EXEC TEST: Minimum Hold Period + Strict Hold
# Tests: E01 (hold_long, strict_hold), E02 (signal persistence)
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c

# === SIGNAL: Breakout with ADX filter ===
donchian = donchian_channel(window=20)(src.h, src.l)
upper = donchian.donchian_upper >> 1
lower = donchian.donchian_lower >> 1

# ADX trend filter
adx_val = adx(period=14)(src.h, src.l)
trending = adx_val > 20

# E02: hold_until to persist breakout state, then AND with filter
breakout_up = close > upper
breakout_down = close < lower
held_long = hold_until()(enter=breakout_up, exit=breakout_down)
held_short = hold_until()(enter=breakout_down, exit=breakout_up)

long_entry = held_long and trending
short_entry = held_short and trending

# === EXECUTION ===
# E01: Minimum 10-bar hold with strict_hold
long_and_short_zone(hold_long=10, hold_short=10, strict_hold=True)(
    long_entry=long_entry, short_entry=short_entry
)

# Fixed sizing
position_size(type=SizeType.percent)(size=25)

# ATR stop
atr_val = atr(period=14)(src.h, src.l, src.c)
stop_loss(unit=StopUnit.price)(distance=atr_val * 3)
